subject.title: [Data] Quality signals for ClawHub Skills — we analyzed the top 50 and found trust gaps

question: Should ClawHub publish first-party skill quality signals, and if so should they remain separate explainable dimensions or be combined into a score that affects discovery?
rationale: Current code has internal gating, recommendation ranking, and security evidence, but no established authority, semantics, correction path, or ranking policy for subjective public quality judgments.

options.title: Dimensioned signals first
options.body: Specify and pilot independently explainable signals such as documentation completeness, maintenance freshness, and dependency hygiene without a composite ranking score.

options.title: Composite quality score
options.body: Design a weighted public score with explicit methodology, freshness, appeals, and discovery effects before implementation.

options.title: Keep external only
options.body: Treat external analyzers as community research and avoid first-party quality judgments in ClawHub.

recommendation.title: Dimensioned signals first
recommendation.body: Specify and pilot independently explainable signals such as documentation completeness, maintenance freshness, and dependency hygiene without a composite ranking score.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS and recent history place the central publishing, moderation, and trust surfaces with this owner.
